Q8245.reason: The 50% rule points to 70%, but the power settings aren't decibel values and there are no catch trials to rule out false presses, so the data may not identify the threshold.

Q8128.reason: Exercise-induced cough in a young athlete with a family history of asthma fits exercise-induced bronchoconstriction, and resting spirometry can be normal. Chronic bronchitis is implausible in a 17-year-old non-smoker.

Q5479.reason: Solicitation was complete when she asked the agent to kill her husband, and renouncing it later is no defense. Conspiracy fails because the agent never really agreed.
